Cassidy Rambo: Hey team — first day here! I'm Cassidy, joining Platform Eng on the inference routing squad. Based in PHX, big into plants, sourdough trials, and terrible puns. Also have a corgi-mix named Mochi 🐶
Alex Kim: welcome!! excited to have you on routing — your batching notes looked great :tada:
Marta Lopez: hi Cassidy! quick poll: chips, fruit, or chocolate? choose wisely 🍫🍎🥔
Cassidy Rambo: chips + pickles stan. will trade sourdough starter for cookie recipes 😄
Devon Patel: welcome aboard — if you swing by SF office next week hit me up, I owe you a ramen rec 🍜
Cassidy Rambo: planning to be in SF Thu morning. ramen tour please!
Onboarding Bot: Welcome @Cassidy Rambo! Please: 1) enable 2FA ✅ 2) finish payroll form ✅ 3) join #eng-runtime and #oncall-rotation (use `/join`). Mentor: Alex Kim. Docs: https://internal.redwood/people/onboarding
Jen O'Neill: we do a tiny desk-plant swap monthly — bring something if you'd like 🌱
Priya Sharma: coffee vs tea? react with :coffee: or :tea: and I'll tally ☕️🍵
Cassidy Rambo: coffee. black. strong.
Alex Kim: FYI desk booking is `/deskbook` — e.g. `/deskbook @cassidy 2026-03-25 10:00` if you want the SF desk Thu
Cassidy Rambo: booked Thu 10am. thanks!
Marta Lopez: Mochi pic pls? 😍
Cassidy Rambo: uploaded a pic in-thread — Mochi steals socks and dramatizes everything
Devon Patel: happy to do a quick infra walkthrough tomorrow if you want — 11am slot ok?
Alex Kim: agree, 11am tiny sync to show the codepaths and where to start. no heavy prep.
Jen O'Neill: welcome again Cass — can't wait to grab coffee in person ☕️
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: 1-week check-in scheduled at 1864060800 (auto-created).
Cassidy Rambo: thanks everyone — super pumped to be here!
